ruleDefinitions.name: PowerShell as a Service in Registry
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects that a powershell code is written to the registry as a service. Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Services\\\\.*") AND registry_path = RGX("\\\\ImagePath$") AND (Details = RGX(".*powershell.*") OR Details = RGX(".*pwsh.*")))
